name: hash-lite
description: Hashes text or local files with SHA-256, SHA-1, MD5, and optional SHA-512, and returns hex and Base64. Free, runs on your computer, no API key. Install: `pip install git+https://github.com/tidybytetools/hash-lite` · MCP: `uvx --from git+https://github.com/tidybytetools/hash-lite hash-lite mcp`
